newsitem.title: UK: Sullom Voe Brent terminal suspends berthing.
newsitem.headline: Sullom Voe Brent terminal suspends berthing.

text.p: Berthing was suspended at the Sullom Voe Brent Blend oil terminal on the Shetland Islands because of strong winds which are expected to continue into Friday, a port official said.
He said berthing was suspended at 0448 GMT and winds gusting up to 60 knots were expected over the next couple of days.
"We got one ship in last night before the weather window. The weather forecast is for it to increase today," he said.
The oil tanker was now loading and was scheduled to sail at 2100 GMT but it was not known if it would be able to leave port.
Another two oil tankers were alongside and an LPG tanker was due to arrive later on Thursday. Two more oil tankers were expected on Friday.
Wind speeds were expected to average 45 knots most of the time but the situation was manageable, the official said.
